verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents its own calendar auto-join: the bot can autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe and summarize, and it can automatically record Google Meet calls. That covers the 'connect once and auto-capture' half of the story. The cited Rules Engine governs meeting access and privacy, not which meetings get captured, so it is adjacent and earns no credit here. missing for 10: explicit Google and Outlook calendar connection docs, per-meeting-type auto-capture rules (e.g. internal vs external, by title or attendee), hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically

citations.quote: have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize
